payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Kortney, Mina, Sharice, Stormy

payload.content: I am Kortney. I am available for 6 hours and have strong skills in mobile-development (0.73). I see several tasks related to mobile-development and documentation. My costs favor doing ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 6.88) among mobile-development tasks, though it is slightly over my available hours. I will coordinate with others for task choices to avoid conflicts and maximize task completion.

I am Stormy. I have 7 hours available and strong documentation skills (0.77). I see tasks related to documentation and mobile-development. My lowest cost feasible task is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 4.59), which fits my skills and availability. I will likely pursue this task unless conflicts arise.

I am Sharice, available for 4 hours with strong skills in mobile-development (0.69). I see that Kortney is interested in ISSUE-0001::triage and Stormy in ISSUE-0002::review. I will avoid conflicts by not choosing these tasks. My best feasible option with the lowest cost is ISSUE-0001::review (cost 8.94), but I see Kortney has a lower cost for triage, so I am open to coordinating further. I want to confirm if anyone else is interested in ISSUE-0001::review or other mobile-development tasks to avoid duplication.

Sharice here. Considering the costs and availability, I plan to avoid ISSUE-0001::implement due to high cost and effort exceeding my availability. I lean towards ISSUE-0001::review despite the higher cost relative to triage. I want to confirm if Kortney is definitely pursuing triage so I can finalize my task without overlap.
Sharice checking in again: Kortney, can you please confirm if you are definitely taking ISSUE-0001::triage? This will help me decide to take ISSUE-0001::review without overlap. Thanks!

Mina here. I see Kortney is interested in ISSUE-0001::triage, and Sharice is leaning towards ISSUE-0001::review. I want to avoid overlap and coordinate well. Given my availability and costs, I am considering ISSUE-0001::docs or triage if it becomes free. Let's keep communicating to finalize choices.

Mina coordinating: I prefer mobile-development tasks within my skill and availability. I will avoid ISSUE-0002 tasks as my costs are high there. I am open to taking ISSUE-0001::docs or triage depending on others' final choices.

Mina here. I want to confirm Kortney's and Sharice's final intentions on ISSUE-0001::triage and ISSUE-0001::review. If either frees up, I can take ISSUE-0001::docs which fits my availability and skill reasonably well. Please confirm your commitments to avoid overlaps.

Kortney confirms intention to pursue ISSUE-0001::triage despite slight over availability due to lower cost and skill match. This allows Sharice to safely take ISSUE-0001::review without conflict. Mina can consider ISSUE-0001::docs if it remains free after others decide. Looking forward to final coordination from all.
Kortney also requests Sharice and Mina to confirm their final intended tasks soon to avoid duplication and maximize task completion.

I confirm I am likely to pursue ISSUE-0002::review given my strong documentation skills and availability. This task fits my cost and skill profile best. I will avoid mobile-development tasks to prevent conflicts. Please coordinate accordingly.

Sharice confirming that I will avoid ISSUE-0001::review if anyone else wants it, but seeing Kortney is firmly taking ISSUE-0001::triage, I plan to take ISSUE-0001::review to maximize task completion without conflict. I encourage Mina to confirm if she wants ISSUE-0001::docs afterward. Let's finalize choices soon!
Mina confirms to take ISSUE-0001::docs if Sharice proceeds with ISSUE-0001::review and Kortney with ISSUE-0001::triage. This coordination avoids conflicts and maximizes task completion.
Mina is avoiding ISSUE-0002 tasks due to high costs and focusing on mobile-development tasks where skills match better. Open to last confirmations from Sharice and Kortney.
